name: Faded Melodies
source:
Introducing Faded Melodies—Harmonize your heart in a world of music and romance!

Enjoy a musical odyssey of love and transformation at Harmony Heights Academy. As a former virtuoso violinist turned junior high music teacher, you'll navigate the echoes of a tragic accident and meet three captivating men: Ryota, the competitive pianist; Eiji, the enigmatic cellist; and Takumi, the eccentric composer. Your decisions will harmonize love, rivalry, and personal growth in this symphony of destiny.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.symphonyotome]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
介绍褪色的旋律——在音乐和浪漫的世界里和谐你的心！

在和谐高地学院享受爱与转变的音乐冒险之旅。作为一名前小提琴演奏家转型为初中音乐老师，你将在一场悲惨事故的回声中航行，并遇到三个迷人的男人：竞技钢琴家Ryota；英二，神秘的大提琴家；还有古怪的作曲家巧。你的决定将在这首命运交响乐中协调爱情、竞争和个人成长。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.symphonyotome]Google Play[/url]]
